AdjustmentType.title: AdjustmentType
AdjustmentType.description: Manual changes of the total (PRD stockAdjustmentType).

AdminPaymentResponse.title: AdminPaymentResponse
AdminPaymentResponse.description: A payment for the panel: no raw gateway event (it stays in the database).

ApplyCodeRequest.title: ApplyCodeRequest
ApplyCodeRequest.description:
Only the code text; its shape is checked after the rate limit, in the service, so a
malformed code is a counted failed attempt like any wrong code (ADR-043).

CallbackResponse.title: CallbackResponse
CallbackResponse.description: The acknowledgement to the gateway; always 200 once processed (ADR-051).

CategorySummary.title: CategorySummary
CategorySummary.description: Public card of a category: enough for menus, breadcrumbs and sub-category links.

CheckoutRequest.title: CheckoutRequest
CheckoutRequest.description: Only ids: every amount comes from the server (CLAUDE.md §8).

ColorSwatch.title: ColorSwatch
ColorSwatch.description: A colour option and its swatch (#RRGGBB, or null when the admin set none; D42).

CreateOrderRequest.title: CreateOrderRequest
CreateOrderRequest.description: Ids and the expected quote fingerprint only: every amount comes from the server.

FakeCompleteRequest.title: FakeCompleteRequest
FakeCompleteRequest.description: The customer's action on the fake gateway's page (development only).

InitPaymentRequest.title: InitPaymentRequest
InitPaymentRequest.description: Only the order: the amount always comes from the order's stored grand_total.

InventoryRow.title: InventoryRow
InventoryRow.description: One variant's stock across active warehouses; ``reserved`` excludes expired holds.

OrderDetailResponse.title: OrderDetailResponse
OrderDetailResponse.description:
The placed order plus its payments, history and what the customer can do now.

``reservation_expires_at`` is the reservation's current end. A GET never writes, so an
unpaid order past its deadline stays ``pending_payment`` (with ``can_pay`` and
``can_cancel`` false) until the expiry job cancels it (ADR-050).

OrderHistoryResponse.title: OrderHistoryResponse
OrderHistoryResponse.description: One status change; the actor is not shown to the customer.

OrderPaymentResponse.title: OrderPaymentResponse
OrderPaymentResponse.description: One payment attempt; no gateway reference or raw gateway data.

OrderStatusResponse.title: OrderStatusResponse
OrderStatusResponse.description: The order's current statuses after a cancel (ORD-06); the full view is ACC-01.

ProductAvailabilityResponse.title: ProductAvailabilityResponse
ProductAvailabilityResponse.description: Stock status only; stock numbers stay internal (ADR-029).

ProductCard.title: ProductCard
ProductCard.description: Explicit allowlist, like the detail: no stock numbers or internal fields.

ProductDetailResponse.title: ProductDetailResponse
ProductDetailResponse.description: Explicit allowlist: no stock numbers, thresholds, price versions or actor ids.

ProductPricingResponse.title: ProductPricingResponse
ProductPricingResponse.description: Server-computed prices only: no price version, tax flag or stock numbers.

ProfileResponse.title: ProfileResponse
ProfileResponse.description: The current user; roles and permissions are read from the database per request.

RecordRefundRequest.title: RecordRefundRequest
RecordRefundRequest.description:
The bank reference of a full manual refund (ADM-08, D35).

``amount`` is only for a payment whose gateway figure is unknown (``paid_amount``
null): then it is required, in Toman, at most the order total. ``note`` is kept in
the audit log: never put customer data in it (card number, IBAN, mobile).

ReplaceCategoryFiltersRequest.title: ReplaceCategoryFiltersRequest
ReplaceCategoryFiltersRequest.description: The complete new filter set of the category; it replaces the current one.

ReservationStatus.title: ReservationStatus
ReservationStatus.description:
Lifecycle of a reservation (PRD «موجودی و رزرو» ✓). ``active`` past ``expires_at`` is
already inactive for every check; the job only cleans it up to ``expired`` (ADR-036).

StockResponse.title: StockResponse
StockResponse.description: Admin-only numbers; public responses carry only the status (ADR-029).

TokenResponse.title: TokenResponse
TokenResponse.description: Access token only; the refresh token travels in an HttpOnly cookie (ADR-012).

UpdateCategoryRequest.title: UpdateCategoryRequest
UpdateCategoryRequest.description: Partial update; only the fields present in the body are changed.

UpdateDiscountRequest.title: UpdateDiscountRequest
UpdateDiscountRequest.description: Sent fields change; ``code`` and ``type`` are accepted only unchanged (service).

UpdateInventoryRequest.title: UpdateInventoryRequest
UpdateInventoryRequest.description:
A stock adjustment, a new low-stock threshold, or both, with one reason.

``expected_total`` guards against a repeated submit: the change applies only while the
stored total still equals it (409 otherwise).

UpdatePageRequest.title: UpdatePageRequest
UpdatePageRequest.description: Sent fields change; the slug is fixed at creation, so sending it is a 400.

UpdatePriceRequest.title: UpdatePriceRequest
UpdatePriceRequest.description:
Fields sent are changed; fields left out keep their value.

Checks that need only the body are 400 here; checks against the stored price are 422
in the service (ADR-011, ADR-035).

UpdateProductRequest.title: UpdateProductRequest
UpdateProductRequest.description:
Partial update; ``attributes`` replaces the whole set when present.

``status`` is rejected (400 unknown field) instead of ignored: it has its own endpoint.

UpdateProfileRequest.title: UpdateProfileRequest
UpdateProfileRequest.description:
Only these fields are editable; anything else (mobile, role, status...) is a 400.

Omitted fields are left unchanged; ``email: null`` clears the email.

UpdateShipmentRequest.title: UpdateShipmentRequest
UpdateShipmentRequest.description: The next shipment status; ``shipped`` needs the carrier tracking code (ADM-02).

UpdateShippingMethodRequest.title: UpdateShippingMethodRequest
UpdateShippingMethodRequest.description: Sent fields change; null clears only the nullable ones.

UpdateUserRolesRequest.title: UpdateUserRolesRequest
UpdateUserRolesRequest.description: The complete new role set of the user; it replaces the current one.

UpdateVariantRequest.title: UpdateVariantRequest
UpdateVariantRequest.description: Partial update without prices: price fields are ignored like system fields (PRD).

VariantOptions.title: VariantOptions
VariantOptions.description: At most one value per key; an empty object is the product's default variant.
